fix(components): [input-number] keep aria attributes in sync with props (#25024)

* fix(components): [input-number] keep aria attributes in sync with props

The aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-disabled attributes were only
written once in onMounted, while aria-valuenow was refreshed in
onUpdated. Changing min, max or disabled at runtime left the spinbutton
announcing stale bounds to assistive technologies.

Move all attribute writes into a single updateAriaAttributes helper that
runs both on mount and on update.

* chore: tweak

* chore: tweak
